P: Tappetar，[n．ag．to tappeti] one who satisfies，a giver of good things in comb<sup>n</sup> titto ca tappetā ca：self-satisfied & satisfying others A．I，87； Pug．27 （of a Sammāsambuddha）．（Page 297）
DOP: tappeta(r) m. [ from tappati 2 ], one who satisfies; one who gladdens ; A I 87, 7 (titto ca ~ā ca, ime kho bhikkhave dve puggalā dullabhā lokasmin ti; Mp II 156, 29 : pacceka-buddho ca tathāgatasāvako ca khīṇāsavo titto nāma tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho titto ca ~ā ca); Pp 27, 3 (sammāsambuddho titto ca ~ā ca; Pp-a 206, 13 : ~ā ti aññesaṃ pi tittikaro).
NCP: masculine Also written as: tappetar one who satisfies; one who gladdens.

tappeti.p: [Tappa+ṇe+ti] (kā,kri) CL=7 [Dhātvattha. 157.] (A) It let him to be satisfy. (B) It makes increase, It makes to be full of. (C) It makes to be tire. (D) It makes to be worry or hot.
a: တပ္ပေတိ(ကာ၊ကြိ)

D: Tappeti，（tapp + e），饱足，使满足。 【过】 ~esi。 【现分】 tappenta。 【独】tappetvā，tappiya。（p143）
